rule: Normal active CI runs cargo test --workspace --locked and every active test passes. A test that genuinely cannot run in normal CI (Julia toolchain on a specific runner, bench hardware) is registered here, never dropped: it is marked #[ignore = "REGISTERED_PLATFORM_TEST:<id>"] and has one entry below. No other #[ignore] or cfg_attr(..., ignore) is allowed in workspace crates; missing evidence is asserted as a fail-closed status, never skipped.

entry_fields.path: repository-relative path of the source file holding the test
entry_fields.reason: why it cannot run in normal CI
entry_fields.owner_or_evidence_basis: owner decision or evidence record that requires the test
entry_fields.required_trigger: when it must run (workflow_dispatch, schedule, arrival of P1 / P2 bench evidence, ...)

check: crates/abep-ci/src/test_register.rs (cargo test -p abep-ci; CI: abep-ci test-register): every ignore attribute carries a registered marker on the registered path and function, and every entry matches exactly one marked test
